title: Harrington's Fukushima delegation visit
summary: John Harrington tells of Harrington's Fukushima delegation visit, about after 2011 at Japan (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: out we were with there the guy that led the delegation on what happened and and Fukushima did not kill anybody.

plain: John Harrington, who says he served as US Secretary of Energy, says that after the 2011 disaster at Japan's Fukushima nuclear power plant he went there with a delegation. He says the man who led the group explained what had happened, and that the Fukushima accident did not kill anybody.
